_about: A raw FreeCAD context for the corpus, recorded with tools/record_context.py.

descriptions.Part_CoordinateSystem: Creates a coordinate system that can be attached to other objects
descriptions.Part_DatumLine: Creates a datum line that can be attached to other objects
descriptions.Part_DatumPlane: Creates a datum plane that can be attached to other objects
descriptions.Part_DatumPoint: Creates a datum point that can be attached to other objects
descriptions.Part_SelectFilter: Only allows the selection of vertices
descriptions.Sketcher_ArcOverlay: Toggles the visibility of the circular helpers for all arcs
descriptions.Sketcher_BSplineConvertToNURBS: Converts the selected geometry to B-splines
descriptions.Sketcher_BSplineDecreaseDegree: Decreases the degree of the B-spline
descriptions.Sketcher_BSplineIncreaseDegree: Increases the degree of the B-spline
descriptions.Sketcher_BSplineInsertKnot: Inserts a knot at a given parameter. If a knot already exists at that parameter, its multiplicity is increased by 1.
descriptions.Sketcher_CarbonCopy: Copies the geometry of another sketch
descriptions.Sketcher_CompBSplineShowHideGeometryInfo: Toggles the visibility of the degree for all B-splines
descriptions.Sketcher_CompModifyKnotMultiplicity: Increases the multiplicity of the selected knot of a B-spline
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainAngle: Constrains the angle between two straight lines or between one line and the X-axis of the sketch if only one is selected
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainBlock: Constrains the selected edges as fixed
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainCoincidentUnified: Constrains the selected elements to be coincident
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainDiameter: Constrains the diameter of the selected circle or arc
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainDistance: Constrains the vertical distance between two points, or from a point to the origin if one is selected
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainDistanceX: Constrains the horizontal distance between two points, or from a point to the origin if only one is selected
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainDistanceY: Constrains the vertical distance between the selected elements
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainEqual: Constrains the selected edges or circles to be equal
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainHorVer: Constrains the selected elements either horizontally or vertically, based on their closest alignment
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainLock: Constrains the selected vertices by adding horizontal and vertical distance constraints
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainParallel: Constrains the selected lines to be parallel
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainPerpendicular: Constrains the selected lines to be perpendicular
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainRadiam: Constrains the radius of the selected arc or the diameter of the selected circle
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainRadius: Constrains the radius of the selected circle or arc
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainSymmetric: Constrains the selected elements to be symmetric
descriptions.Sketcher_ConstrainTangent: Constrains the selected elements to be tangent or collinear
descriptions.Sketcher_Create3PointArc: Creates an arc defined by 2 end points and 1 point on the arc
descriptions.Sketcher_Create3PointCircle: Creates a circle from 3 perimeter points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateArc: Creates an arc defined by a center point and an end point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateBSpline: Creates a B-spline curve defined by control points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateBSplineByInterpolation: Creates a B-spline from knots, i.e. from interpolation
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateChamfer: Creates a chamfer between 2 selected lines or at coincident points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateCircle: Creates a circle from a center and rim point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateEllipseBy3Points: Creates an ellipse from 3 points on its perimeter
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateEllipseByCenter: Creates an ellipse from a center and rim point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateFillet: Creates a fillet between 2 selected lines or at coincident points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateHeptagon: Creates a heptagon from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateHexagon: Creates a hexagon from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateOblong: Creates a rounded rectangle from 2 corner points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateOctagon: Creates an octagon from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreatePentagon: Creates a pentagon from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreatePeriodicBSpline: Creates a periodic B-spline curve defined by control points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreatePeriodicBSplineByInterpol: Creates a periodic B-spline defined by knots using interpolation
descriptions.Sketcher_CreatePolyline: Creates a continuous polyline. Press the 'M' key to switch segment modes
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateRectangle: Creates a rectangle from 2 corner points
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateRectangle_Center: Creates a centered rectangle from a center and a corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateRegularPolygon: Creates a regular polygon from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateSquare: Creates a square from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_CreateTriangle: Creates an equilateral triangle from a center and corner point
descriptions.Sketcher_Dimension: Constrains contextually based on the selection. The type can be changed with the M key.
descriptions.Sketcher_EditSketch: Opens the selected sketch for editing
descriptions.Sketcher_Extend: Extends an edge with respect to the selected position
descriptions.Sketcher_Intersection: Creates the intersection of external geometry with the sketch plane
descriptions.Sketcher_JoinCurves: Joins 2 curves at selected end points
descriptions.Sketcher_MapSketch: Attaches a sketch to the selected geometry element
descriptions.Sketcher_MergeSketches: Creates a new sketch by merging at least 2 selected sketches
descriptions.Sketcher_MirrorSketch:
Creates a new mirrored sketch for each selected sketch
by using the X or Y axes, or the origin point,
as mirroring reference
descriptions.Sketcher_Offset: Adds an equidistant closed contour around selected geometry: positive values offset outward, negative values inward
descriptions.Sketcher_Projection: Creates the projection of external geometry in the sketch plane
descriptions.Sketcher_RemoveAxesAlignment: Modifies the constraints to remove axes alignment while trying to preserve the constraint relationship of the selection
descriptions.Sketcher_ReorientSketch:
Places the selected sketch on one of the global coordinate planes.
This will clear the AttachmentSupport property.
descriptions.Sketcher_RestoreInternalAlignmentGeometr: Toggles the visibility of all internal geometry
descriptions.Sketcher_Rotate: Rotates the selected geometry by creating 'n' copies, enabling circular pattern creation
descriptions.Sketcher_SelectConstraints: Selects the constraints associated with the selected geometrical elements
descriptions.Sketcher_SelectElementsAssociatedWithCon: Selects the geometrical elements associated with the selected constraints
descriptions.Sketcher_Split: Splits an edge into 2 segments while preserving constraints
descriptions.Sketcher_SwitchVirtualSpace: Switches the selected constraints or the view to the other virtual space
descriptions.Sketcher_Symmetry: Creates a mirrored copy of the selected geometry
descriptions.Sketcher_ToggleActiveConstraint: Toggles the state of the selected constraints
descriptions.Sketcher_ToggleConstruction: Toggles between defining geometry and construction geometry modes
descriptions.Sketcher_ToggleDrivingConstraint: Toggles between driving and reference mode of the selected constraints and commands
descriptions.Sketcher_Translate: Translates the selected geometries and enables the creation of 'i' * 'j' copies
descriptions.Sketcher_Trimming: Trims an edge with respect to the selected position
descriptions.Sketcher_ValidateSketch:
Validates a sketch by checking for missing coincidences,
invalid constraints, and degenerate geometry
descriptions.Sketcher_ViewSection: Toggles between section view and full view
descriptions.Sketcher_ViewSketch: Aligns the camera orientation perpendicular to the active sketch plane
descriptions.Std_AlignToSelection: Aligns the camera view to the selected elements in the 3D view
descriptions.Std_Copy: Copies the selection to the clipboard
descriptions.Std_Cut: Removes the selection and copies it to the clipboard
descriptions.Std_DlgMacroExecute: Opens a dialog to execute a recorded macro
descriptions.Std_DlgMacroExecuteDirect: Executes the macro in the editor
descriptions.Std_DlgMacroRecord: Opens a dialog to record a macro
descriptions.Std_Group: Creates a group, which is a general-purpose container to group objects in the tree view, regardless of their data type. It is a simple folder to organize the objects in a model.
descriptions.Std_LinkImportAll: Imports all links of the active document
descriptions.Std_LinkMake: A link is an object that references another object, either within the same or in another document. Unlike clones, links reference the original shape directly, making them more memory-efficient, which helps with the creation of complex assemblies.
descriptions.Std_LinkMakeRelative: Creates a sub-object or sub-element link
descriptions.Std_LinkReplace: Replaces the selected objects with links
descriptions.Std_LinkUnlink: Unlinks the object by placing it directly in the container
descriptions.Std_Open: Opens a document or imports files
descriptions.Std_Part: Creates a part, which is a general-purpose container to group objects so they act as a unit in the 3D view. It is intended to arrange objects that have a part TopoShape, like part primitives, Part Design bodies, and other parts.
descriptions.Std_Paste: Pastes the contents of the clipboard
descriptions.Std_SelBack: Restores the previous tree view selection. Only works if tree RecordSelection mode is switched on.
descriptions.Std_SelForward: Restores the next tree view selection. Only works if tree RecordSelection mode is switched on.
descriptions.Std_TreeCollapseDocument: Expands the active document and collapses all others
descriptions.Std_TreeDrag: Initiates dragging of the currently selected tree items
descriptions.Std_TreeMultiDocument: Displays all documents in the tree view
descriptions.Std_TreePreSelection: Preselects the object in 3D view when hovering the cursor over the tree item
descriptions.Std_TreeRecordSelection: Records the selection in the tree view in order to go back/forward using the navigation buttons
descriptions.Std_TreeSelection: Scrolls to the first selected item
descriptions.Std_TreeSingleDocument: Displays only the active document in the tree view
descriptions.Std_TreeSyncPlacement: Adjusts the placement on drag-and-drop of objects across coordinate systems (e.g. in part containers)
descriptions.Std_TreeSyncSelection: Expands the tree item when the corresponding object is selected in the 3D view
descriptions.Std_TreeSyncView: Switches to the 3D view containing the selected item from the tree view
descriptions.Std_VarSet: Creates a variable set, which is an object that maintains a set of properties to be used as variables
descriptions.Std_ViewBottom: Sets the camera to the bottom view
descriptions.Std_ViewFitAll: Fits all content into the 3D view
descriptions.Std_ViewFitSelection: Fits the selected content into the 3D view
descriptions.Std_ViewFront: Sets the camera to the front view
descriptions.Std_ViewIsometric: Sets the camera to the isometric view
descriptions.Std_ViewLeft: Sets the camera to the left view
descriptions.Std_ViewRear: Sets the camera to the rear view
descriptions.Std_ViewRight: Sets the camera to the right view
descriptions.Std_ViewTop: Sets the camera to the top view
descriptions.Std_WhatsThis: Opens the documentation for the selected command
descriptions.TalkToMe_Microphone: Talk to me: switch the microphone on or off
